methods.name: Filecoin.ChainGetPath
methods.summary:
ChainGetPath returns a set of revert/apply operations needed to get from
one tipset to another, for example:
```
       to
        ^
from   tAA
  ^     ^
tBA    tAB
 ^---*--^
     ^
    tRR
```
Would return `[revert(tBA), apply(tAB), apply(tAA)]`
